en.content: A wire of length 2L, is made by joining two wires A and B of same length but different radii r and 2r and made of the same material. It is vibrating at a frequency such that the joint of the two wires forms a node. If the number of antinodes in wire A is p and that in B is q then the ratio p : q is :
en.explanation:
Let mass per unit length of wires are 1 and 2 respectively

Materials are same, so density will be same.

and

Tension in both are same = T, let speed of wave in wires are V1 and V2



Frequency at which both resonate is L.C.M. of both frequencies (i.e : )

Hence number of loops in wires are 1 and 2 respectively

So, ratio of number of antinodes is 1 : 2.

Energy released for tension n = 2 to n = 1 of hydrogen atom



Z = 1, n1 = 1, n2 = 2
